name: Commited – Shopping CO2 neutralization add-on for WooCommerce
author: commitedapp

sections.description:
Commited – Shopping CO2 neutralization add-on for WooCommerce provides an intelligent customer experience for your e-commerce site. It tracks customer cart activities and displays personalized CO2 neutralization offers after payment completion, helping your customers make their shopping carbon-neutral.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Commited API service to provide CO2 neutralization calculations and offers. Below is detailed information about the external service usage:

Service Provider: Commited (https://commited.app)

Service Purpose:
– Calculate carbon footprint of shopping cart items
– Provide personalized CO2 neutralization offers
– Display interactive widget with mascot animations

Data Sent to External Service:
– Cart Items: Product names, prices, quantities, currency, and product image URLs
– When Sent:
– When items are added to/removed from the cart
– When cart quantities are updated
– During checkout process
– After order completion
– Purpose: To calculate CO2 emissions and generate personalized carbon offset offers

Service Endpoints:
– API Endpoint: https://services.commited.app (configurable in plugin settings)
– API Paths: /api/octinel/start-workflow, /api/octinel/history

User Account Required: Yes, users need to register with Commited service and configure their site slug in plugin settings

Terms of Service: https://commited.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://commited.app/privacy

Data Handling:
– All data is transmitted securely over HTTPS
– Cart data is used solely for CO2 calculation purposes
– No personal customer information is transmitted beyond what’s necessary for the calculation
– Users can disable the widget at any time from plugin settings

Features

  • Automatic Cart Tracking: Automatically detects WooCommerce cart activities
  • Post-Checkout Widget: Displays personalized CO2 neutralization offers after payment completion
  • Customizable Appearance: Adjust widget size and position from admin panel
  • WooCommerce Blocks Compatible: Fully compatible with new WooCommerce block editor
  • HPOS Compatible: Supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
  • Responsive Design: Perfect appearance on mobile and desktop devices
  • Multi-Currency Support: TRY, USD, EUR, GBP support
  • Admin Settings Panel: Easy configuration interface

Resources

  • Plugin URI: https://commited.app
  • Author URI: https://commited.app
  • GitHub: https://github.com/commited/commited-co2-neutralization-woocommerce
sections.installation:
1. Eklenti dosyalarını /wp-content/plugins/commited-shopping-co2-neutralization-add-on-for-woocommerce klasörüne yükleyin
  2. WordPress admin panelinden “Eklentiler” menüsüne gidin
  3. “Commited – Shopping CO2 neutralization add-on for WooCommerce” eklentisini etkinleştirin
  4. Ayarlar > Commited CO2 Nötrleştirme sayfasından yapılandırma yapın
  5. API endpoint ve site slug bilgilerinizi girin
sections.faq:
Bu eklenti WooCommerce gerektirir mi?

Evet, Commited – Shopping CO2 neutralization add-on for WooCommerce çalışmak için WooCommerce eklentisinin yüklü ve aktif olmasını gerektirir.

Widget hangi sayfalarda görünür?

Widget özellikle checkout sonrası “Thank You” sayfasında görünür. Ancak sepet işlemlerini arka planda takip eder.

API endpoint nedir?

Commited servisi ile iletişim kurmak için gereken URL’dir.

Site slug nedir ve nereden bulurum?

Site slug, Commited sisteminde tanımlı sitenizin benzersiz tanımlayıcısıdır. Commited hesap yöneticinizden bu bilgiyi alabilirsiniz.

Widget’ı devre dışı bırakabilir miyim?

Evet, Ayarlar > Commited CO2 Nötrleştirme sayfasından “Widget’ı etkinleştir” seçeneğini kaldırarak widget’ı devre dışı bırakabilirsiniz.

Mobil cihazlarda çalışır mı?

Evet, widget responsive tasarımı sayesinde tüm cihazlarda düzgün çalışır.
